evidence: Judged “It’s already a real piece of community, and it can still make a difference when people are going through a divorce, an illness or grief.” against his line (“A weekly group that has practiced together for two years already contains a real piece of community. It may never own land.”) and the sentence it replaces (“It can still make a difference when people are going through a divorce, an illness or grief.”). The point that a practice group already is community is back, in his words “already” and “a real piece of community”; the group, its weekly practice for two years and “may never own land” are in the unchanged sentence above it in CONTEXT. The one shift is “contains a real piece of community” to “is a real piece of community”, the same claim in his casual register; “piece of” stays, so it does not overclaim “is community”. “It” is the group, with “So what?” between them, and the replaced sentence already opened with the same “It”. The rest of the sentence is the replaced sentence unchanged. Nothing added: no person, number or condition. Tells: T24 considered (“So what?” followed by the answer) and judged ABSENT, because the question is the reader’s real objection (no land), sits outside the draft, and is answered with his point; T21 absent (two clauses, his two points). All other rows ABSENT. Lint: D9 accepted (his line put back, one sentence).
